actions.label: Create CRM contact
actions.description: Persists a new contact record with PII to the CRM store.

actions.label: Change deal stage
actions.description: Mutates pipeline stage and forecast surface.

actions.label: Schedule payment
actions.description: Queues a future-dated outbound payment from an owner-controlled account.

actions.label: Assign household task
actions.description: Assigns or reassigns a household task to a member.

actions.label: Confirm travel booking
actions.description: Confirms a flight, lodging, or transport reservation against a vendor.

actions.label: Engage autonomy kill-switch
actions.description: Halts every advisor controller, standing mission, and queue execution at the next state check.

actions.label: Release autonomy kill-switch
actions.description: Resumes advisor controllers and standing missions after a halt.

actions.label: Escalate support case
actions.description: Routes a support case to a higher tier or specialist role.

actions.label: Bulk import contacts
actions.description: Persists many contact records at once from an external CSV source.

actions.label: Change envelope allocation
actions.description: Reallocates funds between household money envelopes.

actions.label: Send invoice
actions.description: Dispatches an invoice to a customer email.

actions.label: Delete CRM contact
actions.description: Permanently removes a contact and associated PII.

actions.label: Send email campaign
actions.description: Sends a bulk email campaign to a contact segment.

actions.label: Send external calendar invite
actions.description: Creates an external-facing calendar invitation.

actions.label: Execute transfer
actions.description: Moves funds between accounts.

actions.label: Adjust budget
actions.description: Modifies a budget category limit.

actions.label: Place buy order
actions.description: Submits a buy order to a brokerage.

actions.label: Place sell order
actions.description: Submits a sell order to a brokerage.

actions.label: Cancel recurring payment
actions.description: Stops a recurring outbound payment.

actions.label: Purchase gift
actions.description: Buys a gift on behalf of the user.

actions.label: Cancel reservation
actions.description: Cancels a confirmed reservation.

actions.label: Send message to contact
actions.description: Sends a message to an external contact.

actions.label: Update health profile
actions.description: Modifies the user's sensitive health profile.

actions.label: Log health metric
actions.description: Records a health metric (weight, BP, etc.).

actions.label: Share health record
actions.description: Shares a health record with a third party.

actions.label: Book health appointment
actions.description: Books a medical appointment with a provider.

actions.label: Log medication
actions.description: Records a medication intake event.

actions.label: Delete memory
actions.description: Permanently removes a memory entry.

actions.label: Add memory
actions.description: Saves a new memory entry.

actions.label: Delete workspace
actions.description: Removes a workspace and its scoped data.

actions.label: Create workspace
actions.description: Creates a new workspace.

actions.label: Delete file
actions.description: Permanently deletes a file from storage.

actions.label: Send notification
actions.description: Sends a notification to the user.

actions.label: Revoke session
actions.description: Terminates an active device session.
